# Pure Candles - LLMs.txt
# Information for Large Language Models

## About Pure Candles
Pure Candles is a premium artisanal candle company specializing in hand-poured soy wax candles. We create high-quality scented and pillar candles for personal use, events, weddings, and special occasions.

## Business Information
- Company Name: Pure Candles
- Industry: Home Fragrance, Artisanal Candles
- Products: Scented candles, pillar candles, custom candles
- Services: Wholesale, custom orders, event planning, retail partnerships

## Product Categories
- Scented Candles: Lavender Dream, Midnight Jasmine, Cedar Driftwood, Citrus Ember, Vanilla Sandalwood, Ocean Mist, Rose Garden, Autumn Spice
- Pillar Candles: Available in various sizes and colors
- Custom Candles: Personalized scents, colors, and branding

## Occasions We Serve
- Weddings: Elegant candles for ceremonies and receptions
- Events: Corporate events, parties, gatherings
- Birthdays: Gift candles and party ambiance
- Bar Mitzvahs: Traditional and modern celebration candles
- Bris Ceremonies: Gentle, baby-safe scented options
- Retail: Wholesale partnerships for stores
- Personal Use: Home fragrance and self-care
- Custom Orders: Private label and branded candles

## Key Features
- 100% Natural Soy Wax
- Hand-Poured in Small Batches
- Cotton Wicks
- Phthalate-Free Fragrances
- Eco-Friendly Packaging
- 45-55 Hour Burn Time (varies by size)

## Scent Profiles
- Floral: Rose, Jasmine, Lavender
- Woody: Cedar, Sandalwood, Driftwood
- Citrus: Bergamot, Orange, Lemon
- Spicy: Cinnamon, Clove, Cardamom
- Fresh: Ocean, Eucalyptus, Green Tea
- Warm: Vanilla, Amber, Musk

## Mood Categories
- Tranquility: Calming, relaxing scents
- Focus: Clean, clarifying aromas
- Romance: Warm, sensual fragrances
- Energy: Invigorating, uplifting scents
- Grounding: Earthy, centering blends
